calendarFaqs.q: When does Spring ISD school start in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: Most Spring ISD campuses start Wednesday, August 12, 2026. Bailey Middle School and Ponderosa Elementary follow the ACE calendar and start Monday, August 10.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Spring ISD Spring Break in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: Spring Break is March 15–19, 2027. The separate Spring Holiday is Friday, March 26.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day of school for Spring ISD in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: The standard calendar ends Friday, May 28, 2027, on an early-release schedule. Families at ACE campuses should use their separate calendar.

calendarFaqs.q: When do Spring ISD students return after Winter Break?
calendarFaqs.a: Students on the standard calendar return Tuesday, January 5, 2027. January 4 is a Professional Development Day with no students.

calendarFaqs.q: Are there early-release or no-student days on the Spring ISD 2026–27 calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: Yes. No-student days include November 2–3, January 4 and February 19. The PDF marks high-school-only early release on December 17 and May 27, and districtwide early release on December 18, February 18 and May 28. February 15–17 have conditional or selected-student schedules.

calendarFaqs.q: Do all Spring ISD campuses follow this calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: No. Bailey Middle School and Ponderosa Elementary use a separate ACE calendar and start August 10. Spring Early College Academy may also adjust dates to align with Lone Star College classes.

sourceReviewSummary: Reviewed August 19, 2026 against the Spring ISD printable calendars page, the current and prior-year instructional calendar PDFs, and the district's ACE campus notice.
sourceReviewDetails: The August 12 first day, May 28 last day, major breaks and March 26 Spring Holiday were checked against the revised district PDF.
Daily PDF symbols were checked for early release, no-student days, the conditional February 15 make-up day and February 16–17 Intervention Days.
The district notice confirms that Bailey Middle School and Ponderosa Elementary use the ACE calendar and start August 10.
The standard PDF notes that Spring Early College Academy may adjust dates to match Lone Star College classes.
The first and last days and Spring Holiday were compared with the 2025–26 PDF. Both calendars use day-by-day symbols for the February schedule.
sourceMaintainerText: Spring ISD publishes the source calendars; MySchoolDates organizes the dates and explains attendance exceptions.
sourceNextReviewText: Review again if Spring ISD revises the PDF, activates the February make-up day, changes the ACE schedule or publishes a campus-specific update.
